summary: Frontend bug-fix verification for Sip 'n' Dine: (1) new mandala SVG brand logo + bold serif wordmark, (2) 6 unique Explore tile images. All acceptance criteria verified on Home, /admin login, dashboard, and regression pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin login page and Dashboard header render the mandala SVG + 'Sip \'n\' Dine' wordmark correctly, but they do NOT expose data-testid="brand-logo" (only Layout.jsx Brand does). Consider adding data-testid="brand-logo" on Admin.jsx logo containers for test parity — not blocking.

Home 'home-explore' section contains 6 explore tiles with 6 distinct img.src (5 unsplash + 1 /restaurant/image5.jpeg). All 6 expected labels present (The Menu, Buffet, Private Dining, Catering, Offers, Membership). /admin login shows SVG mandala + 'Sip \'n\' Dine' (single SVG on page, no old script/circle-S). Login succeeded; dashboard header visually shows gold sunburst mandala + serif 'Sip \'n\' Dine' + 'OWNER DASHBOARD · alphaalaneconsulting@gmail.com'.
